## FileDrop.svelte

### `interface Rejection`

- `file` :: The file that was refused.
- `reason` :: Why it was refused.

### `interface Props`

- `files` :: The accepted files. Bindable; works controlled and uncontrolled.
- `onFiles` :: Called with the accepted list whenever it changes.
- `accept` :: A native `accept` string — MIME types, `image/*` wildcards, or extensions such as `.pdf`.
- `multiple` :: Allows more than one file. When false, a new file replaces the current one.
- `maxSize` :: The largest file size in bytes. Larger files are rejected.
- `maxFiles` :: The most files the list may hold. Further files are rejected.
- `showPreviews` :: Render image thumbnail previews for image files in the accepted list.
- `directory` :: Allow selecting directories via native folder picker (`webkitdirectory`).
- `invalid` :: Marks the drop zone invalid. Inside a `Field` it follows the field's error unless set.
- `size` :: The height of the upload disc and the preview thumbnails. @default 'h-xl'
- `gap` :: Space between the drop zone and the file list under it on the shared gap ladder. @default 'gap-sm'
- `surface` :: The surface of each file row in the accepted list. @default 'outlined'
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the preview thumbnails, so they follow the page's shape system. @default 'modern'
- `textSize` :: The scale of the prompt's second line and of a rejection reason. @default 'text-sm'
- `textColor` :: The ink of the prompt's second line, the file icons and the remove buttons; muted by default. @default 'text-muted'
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of a file's size under its name, one step down from the prompt. @default 'text-xs'
- `children` :: The contents of the drop zone, replacing the default prompt.
